get_asset.description: Get a game file, an item or action icon or any other texture, as a PNG, JPEG or WebP image: a public link to it, and the file itself saved as a Lodol document when asked for, to attach or send in a later step. Take the path from a row's Icon field, or give an icon's number.
get_asset.display_str_template: Get the game file {0} from XIVAPI.
get_asset.name: get_asset

parameters.description: The game file's path, such as ui/icon/020000/020601.tex, an icon's number, such as 20601, or a row's Icon field given whole.
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: The image format to convert the file to: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Defaults to PNG.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Whether to take an icon's 80 by 80 version rather than its 40 by 40 one. On by default. Only icons have one.
parameters.name: high_resolution

parameters.description: Optional. The game version to read, such as 7.0 or 7.2x1, as List game versions lists them. Leave empty for the latest. Pin it so a workflow keeps giving the same answers across patches.
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Whether to download the image and save it as a Lodol document, to attach or send in a later step. Off by default: the step then only gives the image's address.
parameters.name: save_as_file

document_ref.description: The saved file's document reference; empty when none was saved.

documents.description: The saved file, as a list a later step can attach or send; empty when none was saved.

url.description: Where Lodol serves the file from.

file_size_bytes.description: The saved file's size in bytes; 0 when none was saved.

file_url.description: Where Lodol serves the saved file from; empty when none was saved.

saved_as_file.description: Whether the image was downloaded and saved as a Lodol document.

url.description: A link to the image, e.g. 'https://v2.xivapi.com/api/asset?path=ui/icon/020000/020601_hr1.tex&format=png'. Public: it works anywhere.

version.description: The game version pinned, e.g. '7.0', or null for the latest.

get_item.description: Get one item by its name or ID, with what its item window shows: description, icon, item and equip level, rarity, category, the jobs that can equip it, stack size, vendor prices, damage and defence, materia slots, and whether it is unique, untradable or can be high quality, in English, Japanese, German or French. A name is matched exactly first, then in any case, then as part of a name only one item has; a name nobody has fails.

item.description: This weak concoction instantly restores a small amount of HP.
item.name: Potion

get_item.name: get_item

parameters.description: The item: its name, such as Potion or Ironworks Tool Set, in the chosen language, or its ID, such as 4551. A search result from the Item sheet can be given whole.

get_map.description: Get the map of a zone or city as an image, by the place's name, such as New Gridania, by the map's id, such as f1t1/00, or from a row of the Map sheet: a public link to it, where it is, and the file itself saved as a Lodol document when asked for. A place with several maps gives its main one.

get_row.description: Read one row of any sheet by its ID, or one subrow as row:subrow, with the fields asked for, or every field when none are, which shows what a sheet holds. Fields of related rows, arrays, other languages and the companion transient sheet can be read too. Pin the game version and schema to keep the answer the same across patches.

parameters.description: The sheet, the game's name for a table of data, such as Item, Action, Quest, Recipe, Mount or Map. Case does not matter. List sheets lists every one.

A related row's field is read with a dot, such as ItemUICategory.Name; a field in every entry of an array with [], such as BaseParam[].Name; a field in another language with @lang, such as Name@lang(ja); a relation as its number alone with @as(raw). Leave empty for every field, which can be a lot.

search.description: Search one or more sheets for rows whose name contains some text, rows matching a query in XIVAPI's own language, or both, in order of relevance, a page at a time. A query is clauses such as +LevelItem>=50 or +ClassJob.Abbreviation="PCT": = is exact, ~ is part of a text, a leading plus means a clause must match and a leading minus that it must not. Read the fields asked for from every result, and page on with the cursor.

Combined with Name contains when both are given.

Leave empty for every field, which can be a lot.

description: Look up Final Fantasy XIV game data through XIVAPI, the free community API that reads the game's own files: every item, action, quest, mount, recipe and map, 7,900 sheets in all, in English, Japanese, German and French, from patch 7.0 to the latest. Get an item by name or ID with its icon, levels, rarity and prices; search any sheet by name or with XIVAPI's query language; read a row or page through a sheet, field by field; list the sheets and game versions; and link to or download an icon, texture or zone map as a PNG, JPEG or WebP. Pin a game version and schema so a workflow keeps giving the same answers across patches. No API key needed.
